newsitems.title: Call of Duty: NEXT and Modern Warfare 4 Early Access Beta: Weekend One Initial I
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][/p][p][/p][p]The countdown to playing [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is almost over. Here's your initial intel on how to watch Call of Duty: NEXT, along with pre-loading the Early Access Beta right now, and the Weekend One content waiting when the [i]Call of Duty[/i] Beta begins this Friday.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Tune in Details: Call of Duty: NEXT[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Join the global [i]Call of Duty[/i] community for Call of Duty: NEXT, live at 9:00 AM PT on Friday, August 21. Serving as the central command center for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], NEXT brings together reveals, developer insights, live gameplay, and creator broadcasts from around the world into one global event.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qeFVhw4YNbM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Then, at 11:00 AM PT, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta officially launches. Deploy alongside players worldwide and be among the first to experience everything Weekend One has to offer in [i]Call of Duty[/i]’s biggest Beta ever.[/p][h2] [/h2][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Early Access Beta: Getting Started[/h2][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta Schedule[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Weekend One (Early Access):[/b] August 21 at 11:00 AM PT – August 25 at 10:00 AM PT[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weekend Two (Open Beta):[/b] August 28 at 10:00 AM PT – September 1 at 10:00 AM PT[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Pre-load the Early Access Beta Now[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p]Pre-loading for the Early Access (Weekend One) Beta is now live on Steam. If you're joining both Beta weekends, you only need to install the Beta once, as any updates and progression will carry over into Weekend Two. Before you deploy, sign in with your Activision Account to ensure your eligible Beta Rewards are tied to your profile and ready when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Early Access Eligibility:[/b] The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Early Access (Weekend One) Beta is available to players who have redeemed a Beta Code or who have pre-ordered or pre-purchased [b]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/b], either the [b]Standard Edition [/b]or the [b]Vault Edition[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] A Beta Code is not needed to play the Early Access Beta if you’ve already pre-ordered a digital version of the game. If you’ve pre-ordered a physical edition of the game, the Beta code will be printed on the retail receipt or sent to you via email on an online receipt.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Redeeming Your Beta Code:[/b] If you’ve acquired a Beta Code, [url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-4/articles/modern-warfare-4-beta-code-support"]click here and follow the instructions to redeem it and access the Beta.[/url] Beta codes for Early Access can be acquired through various promotions prior to the Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How to Access and Launch the Beta[/h3][p][/p][p]Steam (PC)[/p][p]·       [b]Preload (Available Now):[/b] Open the [i]Call of Duty[/i]®: [i]Modern Warfare[/i]® 4 Store page, select Play Now, and Steam will automatically add the Beta to your Library and begin downloading.[/p][p][/p][p]·       [b]Launch (Available at 11:00AM PT on Friday, August 21):[/b] Open your Steam Library and select [i]Call of Duty[/i]®: [i]Modern Warfare[/i]® 4 Beta when the Beta goes live.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta Rewards[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Progress through both Weekends of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta, rank up, and unlock cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Weekend One:[/b] Reach Level 20 to unlock the first five Beta Rewards, culminating with the "Dread Tiger" Operator Skin for Reece.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weekend Two:[/b] Return to continue progressing to Level 30, unlocking all eight Beta Rewards, including the "Beta Forged" Weapon Blueprint for the Han 86 Assault Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]These rewards can only be earned during the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta and will be available in the full game at launch for players who unlock them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6c142460010825ef0043498d35704318789ae77.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Beta Rewards[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Player Level 4:[/b] "Through the Paces" Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 8:[/b] "First Served" Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 12:[/b] "Meonjeo" Legendary Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 16:[/b] "Last Charge" Legendary Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 20:[/b] "Dread Tiger" Operator Skin – Reece[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 23:[/b] "Field Tested" Epic Spray[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 26:[/b] "Beta Rights" Epic Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 30:[/b] "Beta Forged" Weapon Blueprint – Han 86[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Additional Rewards[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. Keep an eye out for additional cosmetic rewards earned through a variety of activities, including:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Default Items (immediately available):[/b] 3 Emblems, 3 Calling Cards, 1 Spray, and 3 Loading Screens[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mobility Course Challenge Reward:[/b] Clockwork Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Record Rewards:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED] Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, and Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward: [/b]\[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Twitch Drops[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Link your Activision account with Twitch to earn additional rewards by watching your favorite creators during Call of Duty: NEXT and throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/261fb3e6000b170812d2d897f733974fe8385146.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: NEXT Twitch Drops[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]These rewards are available for watching the Call of Duty: NEXT broadcast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Gas Ready" Emblem[/b] (for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Rapple Repel" Calling Card[/b] (for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Ghost Helmet"[/b] Charm (for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4 Beta Twitch Drops[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]These rewards are available for watching your favorite creator throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]"Get Tactical" Emblem[/b] (for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Clearing House" Calling Card[/b] (for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Action Ready" Charm[/b] (for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p]For [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/managing-your-activision-profile"][u]further details on linking your Twitch account, click here[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Patch Notes Access[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL: [/b][i]Stay up to date throughout the Modern Warfare 4 Beta with the latest Patch Notes from the Infinity Ward Comms team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07f9045a3dc6a3814608a244e94506de76e5164a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect updates throughout the Beta covering everything from bug fixes and gameplay adjustments to new maps and modes. Visit the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes"][u]Modern Warfare 4 Patch Notes[/u][/url] for the latest intel.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Early Access Beta (Weekend One) Content Intel[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Everything below is available during Weekend One, giving you an early look at the Multiplayer, Campaign, and gameplay systems featured in the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Looking for a deeper dive? [b]Tomorrow, August 21,[/b] we'll publish our [b]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Everything You Need to Know[/b] blog, featuring comprehensive breakdowns of every map, mode, weapon, gameplay system, progression unlock, and more.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Campaign Mission: “Entrenched”[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]NEW:[/b] For the first time in a Call of Duty Beta, play a Campaign mission.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Join a large-scale assault to prevent the destruction of a vital nuclear power station.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Continue the fight with Campaign Early Access starting October 16 for digital pre-orders, ahead of the full game launch on October 23.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b1a9f604122eba7271cfa581ec15c363c8210e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the first time in [i]Call of Duty[/i] Beta history, deploy into a complete Campaign mission before launch. In “Entrenched,” fight alongside friendly infantry and armored vehicles as you battle to prevent a strategically vital nuclear power station from falling into enemy hands.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Mobility Course[/h3][p align="start"][i]Flex your expertise in mobility and make your way through the course as fast as possible.[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]NEW: [/b]Enter a dedicated training facility built to teach Modern Warfare 4's expanded movement and combat systems.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Learn every new maneuver through guided Tutorials before putting your skills to the test in timed Courses.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Return throughout the Beta to improve your ratings, refine your movement, weapon handling, and marksmanship, and build confidence before your next Multiplayer match.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/acc6d9c14a577053a6fa768b35f2e31ff24a6713.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're a new recruit or a returning veteran, the Mobility Course is your proving ground for [i]Modern Warfare 4's[/i]expanded movement and combat systems. Master new traversal techniques, sharpen your gunplay, chase faster completion times, and revisit the Courses whenever you want to fine-tune your skills between Multiplayer matches.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Player Progression (Multiplayer)[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Earn XP in Multiplayer matches to increase your Player Level and unlock new gameplay content.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Weekend One: [/b]Progress from Levels 1-20, unlocking new weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and the first five Beta Rewards.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Weekend Two: [/b]The level cap increases to 30, unlocking the remainder of the Beta's weapons, Equipment, Perks, and the final three Beta Rewards.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Beta Rewards earned during the Open Beta carry over to the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1109307ef7f16d8f9602b8de3a2ef9b313b50108.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Multiplayer match brings you closer to your next player level and new unlock. Climb through the ranks to expand your arsenal, customize your loadouts, and unlock Create a Class at Level 4. Continue earning XP throughout Weekend One, then return for Weekend Two to complete your progression and unlock even more weapons, Equipment, Perks, and Beta Rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Create a Class and Operators[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build up to 12 Custom Loadouts, each with its own Operator, Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]NEW: [/b]Operators are now assigned on a per-loadout basis, giving every Custom Loadout its own identity.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Choose from 21 Operators during the Beta, including military specialists, iconic characters, and additional Operators available with the Vault Edition.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlock Create a Class at Player Level 4 and expand your customization options as you progress.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da996c940de791da23e484ffbb40ce8802732c84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] streamlines Create a Class by bringing every major loadout choice together into a single menu, making it faster than ever to build specialized loadouts for every combat role. Pair a unique Operator with each Custom Loadout, customize your weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks, then fine-tune your setup before every deployment.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Operators are now fully integrated into Create a Class, allowing each loadout to feature its own distinctive look, voice, and interchangeable Finishing Move. The Beta includes 21 Operators to choose from, including Operators available through the Vault Edition, with more arriving at launch.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Weapons, Gunsmith, Apex Attachments, Gunny, and Firing Range[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy with 19 weapons spanning nine weapon classes during Weekend One, with three additional weapons becoming available through Campaign or Default Loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Some Multiplayer weapons unlock at [b]Player Levels 21–30[/b] and therefore become available during Weekend Two.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Customize your arsenal using the returning Gunsmith, then test every build in the Firing Range before deployment.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]NEW:[/b] Unlock powerful Apex Attachments by fully leveling supported weapons, adding unique gameplay effects without using an attachment slot.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]NEW:[/b] Need a starting point? Gunny can instantly recommend a wide variety of Weapon builds using Attachments you've already unlocked.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Additional Weapons arrive with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9aabf73dc4db41e5e23f41c096a7e0f973afdeb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Beta features 19 Multiplayer weapons spanning nine weapon classes. Weekend One gives you access to 14 of those weapons, with the remaining five unlocking as the Player Level cap increases to 30 during Weekend Two. Three additional weapons are accessible through specific Default Loadouts or the Campaign mission, bringing the total number of weapons available across the Beta to 22. Customize supported weapons with Gunsmith, unlock game-changing Apex Attachments by mastering supported weapons, use Gunny to recommend optimized builds, and put every setup through its paces in the Firing Range.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Note: [/b]Looking for the complete arsenal? Tomorrow, August 21, our [i][b]Modern Warfare 4[/b][/i][b] Beta: Everything You Need to Know[/b] blog goes live with the full Beta weapon roster, Gunsmith and Apex Attachment breakdowns, Gunny tips, and complete weapon intel.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Equipment: Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build every loadout with 9 Tactical Equipment items, 11 Lethals, and 11 Field Upgrades, including [b]new equipment in every category[/b].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Weekend One provides access to the majority of your equipment, with 2 additional Tacticals, 3 additional Lethals, and 2 additional Field Upgrades unlocking through Player Levels 21–30 during Weekend Two.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Gather intelligence, breach defended positions, deny enemy movement, defend objectives, and support your squad with equipment tailored to every combat role.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Additional equipment arrives with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/797ecfefb65c96977aa10876dee37065b3635755.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every loadout is more than just your Primary and Secondary weapons. Choose Tactical Equipment to gather intel, disrupt enemy movement, or recover in the heat of battle; Lethal Equipment to clear defenders, deny routes, and secure eliminations; and rechargeable Field Upgrades to support your squad, defend objectives, and create new tactical opportunities. Continue ranking up throughout the Beta to unlock additional equipment during Weekend Two, expanding your tactical options as the Player Level cap increases.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Killstreaks[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Equip up to three Killstreaks to every Custom Loadout before deploying into Multiplayer.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Earn Killstreaks by achieving consecutive eliminations without being eliminated.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The Beta features 17 Killstreaks, with 8 available during Weekend One and 2 additional Killstreaks unlocking through Player Levels 21–30 in Weekend Two.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Additional Killstreaks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381f5017db513dd78139b617122fdfe027332ef4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From reconnaissance and support to devastating offensive firepower, Killstreaks are powerful combat rewards earned through aggressive play and survival. Choose from new and returning Killstreaks to build your preferred combination for each Custom Loadout, then progress throughout the Beta to unlock additional options as the Player Level cap increases to 30 during Weekend Two.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Perks[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Customize your Operator with the Pick 3 Perk System, equipping one Perk from each of three Perk slots.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Choose from 18 Perks during the Beta, with 17 available during Weekend One and 3 additional Perks unlocking through Player Levels 21–30 in Weekend Two.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Mix and match Perks to support aggressive assaults, stealth, survivability, mobility, objective play, and tactical awareness.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Additional Perks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Perks are passive abilities that define how your Operator performs in combat. [i]Modern Warfare 4's[/i] Pick 3 system enables you to build combinations that complement your preferred weapons, Equipment, and overall playstyle, whether you're leading the charge, staying off enemy radar, or supporting your squad. Continue progressing throughout the Beta to unlock additional Perks during Weekend Two to complete your available Beta loadout options.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy into six Core 6v6 Multiplayer modes during Weekend One.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Play Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, Search and Destroy, and NEW: Inflation.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]From classic objective modes to tactical one-life competition, every mode supports full Create a Class functionality.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Additional Multiplayer modes become available as the Beta continues, with more modes at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/231088053f7eca35c47b197b3b57a0db17d79a89.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Weekend One brings together [i]Call of Duty[/i]'s signature Multiplayer experiences with an all-new way to play. Alongside Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, and Search and Destroy, jump into Inflation, where every elimination builds your fortune while turning you into an increasingly valuable target. Each mode rewards a different style of play, from coordinated objective control to tactical, one-life precision.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Core 6v6 Maps[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy across five Core 6v6 maps during Weekend One, each offering its own layout, engagement ranges, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fight across snow-covered rooftops, dense shopping districts, coastal villages, rail terminals, and an overgrown bus depot.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Learn every route, flank, and vantage point before additional maps become available later in the Beta.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]More Core Multiplayer maps arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Every [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta map delivers a distinct combat experience:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd334fc7bca39e62973404044733589e4e598a0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Rooftops:[/b] Traverse the snow-covered rooftops of New York's Hotel Times West using elevated walkways and multiple routes to outmaneuver the opposition.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/006957529cb43b330c26b30ce0ace43aa129a551.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Silkworm:[/b] Push through a dense South Korean shopping district where storefronts, alleyways, and apartments keep engagements fast and unpredictable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/990295c75b98a711ed9bbc49fb2986f4ab155fb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Transit 213:[/b] Navigate an overgrown Indian bus depot divided by rusting buses, concealed routes, and long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711b2c4a159f65fc26d647e1ca26b16d3db24160.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Cachette:[/b] Fight through a secret hideout next to a French rail terminal packed with shipping containers, rooftops, and compact interiors built for constant flanking.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0f7934492e0d5c2468bb0087a3c21567df5da21.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Lotus:[/b] Deploy into a battle-scarred Korean fishing village where narrow streets, burning buildings, and abandoned armor create varied engagements from close quarters to long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block and Gunfight[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]NEW:[/b] Fight across Kill Block, a dynamic combat space that reconfigures every two rounds into a new Combo of three interconnected Slabs.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Experience Gunfight in both classic 3v3 and the NEW 10v10 variant, exclusive to Kill Block.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Every map Combo introduces a new randomized shared Loadout, keeping every round fresh.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Eliminate the opposing team or capture the Overtime Flag to secure victory.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9982d2a8cc3c4b0382389f59c813cc62fd825305.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Kill Block reimagines Gunfight with an ever-changing combat space built from interconnected Slabs. Every two rounds, a new Combo and randomized shared Loadout transform the flow of the match, demanding constant adaptation. Jump into the classic intensity of 3v3 Gunfight or the new 10v10 variant, where larger teams bring an entirely different dynamic—and considerably more mayhem—to Kill Block's evolving arenas.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Call of Duty: Warzone Resurgence — Coming in Weekend Two[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]BREAKING INTEL:[/b] Call of Duty®: Warzone™ joins the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta in Weekend Two, bringing Resurgence to the all-new Zodiac map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/748b7174fb26a06bab7d0f69e83162660af3ab9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battle across the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters, fighting through offices, rooftops, tunnels, and the surrounding shoreline. Deploy with a choice of default loadout, each tailored to [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]™, try to stay alive while teammates redeploy, eliminate enemies and complete Contracts to shorten their return timer, and outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Warzone Resurgence and Zodiac will be available during Weekend Two of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. More intel to follow.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Stand By for Beta Deployment[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The countdown is almost over. Join us for Call of Duty: NEXT at 9:00 AM PT on Friday, August 21, then launch into the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Early Access Beta when Weekend One begins at 11:00 AM PT.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f901e65a1165e0eefbedebba608ddf449166de4.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Tomorrow, return to the Call of Duty Blog for our complete [b]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Everything You Need to Know [/b]blog, with detailed coverage of every map, mode, weapon, gameplay system, progression unlock, and more, across both Weekends of the Beta. Designed as your definitive Beta reference, these overviews and tips will remain available throughout the Beta—and beyond.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Stay frosty: We'll see you in the Beta.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. [h2]Tune in Details: Call of Duty: NEXT[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Join the global Call of Duty community for Call of Duty: NEXT, live at 9:00 AM PT on Friday, August 21. Serving as the command center for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], NEXT brings together reveals, developer insights, live gameplay, and creator broadcasts from around the world into one global event.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qeFVhw4YNbM;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]Immediately following NEXT, at 11:00 AM PT, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta officially launches. Deploy alongside players worldwide and be among the first to experience everything Weekend One has to offer. Return here tomorrow for more details on the Weekend One content.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: PC Specifications[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Planning to deploy into the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta on PC? Check your setup against the Minimum and Recommended PC specifications below to make sure you’re ready for the Beta.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32041265bb850b70661a6811cc8cd99881434f90.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Minimum Specifications[/h3][p align="start"]The minimum PC specifications needed to play the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 64 Bit (latest update)[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU:[/b] AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5-8400[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM:[/b] 12GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – AMD:[/b] Radeon RX 470[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – NVIDIA:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / 1060[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – Intel:[/b] Intel Arc A580[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Memory:[/b] 3 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Space:[/b] SSD required[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Card:[/b] DirectX Compatible[/p][/*][/list][h3]           [/h3][h3]Recommended Specifications[/h3][p align="start"]The recommended PC specifications to play the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 11 64 Bit (latest update)[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU – AMD:[/b] AMD Ryzen 5 3600[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU – Intel:[/b] Intel Core i7-8700[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM:[/b] 16 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – AMD:[/b] AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – NVIDIA:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – Intel:[/b] Intel Arc B580[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Memory:[/b] 8 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Space:[/b] SSD required[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Card:[/b] DirectX Compatible[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Recommended Drivers[/h3][list][*][p][b]NVIDIA:[/b] 610.47[/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD:[/b] 26.7.1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Intel:[/b] 32.0.101.8861[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Required for All PC Specifications[/h3][list][*][p][b]Internet:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] DirectX 12 compatible system[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Requirements:[/b] TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are required to play [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. Other security measures may be enforced. Players can run the Call of Duty Secure Attestation Wizard to verify that their PC meets our security requirements prior to Beta. [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/trusted-platform-module-and-secure-boot"][u]Click here to learn more at the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 and Secure Boot for Call of Duty Support Page[/u][/url].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Note:[/b] These specifications apply to the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta and may differ from the PC specifications for the full game at launch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]PC Players: TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot Requirements[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]PC players:[/b] Before Beta begins, make sure TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are enabled.
These Windows security features help establish a trusted foundation for RICOCHET Anti-Cheat™, especially for [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i] players, and make system-level tampering more difficult, helping protect the integrity of the Beta from Day One.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you have these features already enabled, you're ready for the Beta. If TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot isn’t enabled, you won’t be able to play the Beta online.
[/p][p align="start"]Need help getting set up? Watch our step-by-step guide here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GLhNXlrUrvQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]PC: Shader Preloading Comes to the MW4 Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]Shader Preloading gets a head start on preparing your PC’s shaders before you launch Modern Warfare 4. The result? Less time waiting. More time playing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]PC players:[/b] Shader Preloading is coming to the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta, helping cut down the wait between launching the game and getting into your first match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Shaders: What Are They, and Why Do They Matter?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Shaders are small programs that tell your graphics card — or GPU — how to optimally render what you see on screen, from surfaces and lighting to shadows, visual effects, and more.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]On consoles, developers can optimize for a standardized hardware configuration. PCs are different, with a huge variety of graphics cards, drivers, and system configurations available. That means certain shaders need to be prepared for your specific PC [b]before they can do their job [/b]— [b]rendering graphics properly during gameplay.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]That’s where [b]Shader Preloading[/b] comes in. Shader Preloading prepares these shaders ahead of time, rather than waiting until they’re needed during gameplay. This reduces the amount of shader processing that needs to happen when you play, helping to minimize stutters and other performance hitches.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]What to Do Before You Drop into the Beta[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]With [b]Shader Preloading,[/b] the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta can get a head start by preparing shaders before you launch the game. Moving more of this process outside the game means less time waiting after you boot up, creating a faster route into your first match.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]During the Beta, you may see “Call of Duty®: [i]Modern Warfare® 4[/i]”[i] [/i]appear as a notification in your Windows system tray with a “Shader Pre-Loading Will Start” mention, after you’ve installed or updated your game. Don’t be concerned: this is expected behavior. It means MW4 is preloading shaders in advance so they’re ready when you are.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Shader Preloading uses some system resources while it’s running, but its impact is designed to be minimal. You can continue using your PC while the process runs in the background.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Prefer not to use Shader Preloading? This feature can also be disabled in your settings, and you can interrupt the preloading by right-clicking on this process without consequences, as the preloading will resume once you’re in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Shader Preloading Availability During Beta[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam[/b]: Shader Preloading will be enabled, but a one-time shader compile is still needed on first boot:[/p][list][*][p]First game boot – precompile shaders (similar to how it works today)[/p][/*][*][p]Game launches after subsequent updates – Shader Preloading takes effect[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]This means that for the MW4 Beta, Steam players who play during Weekend One will be able to use Shader Preloading for the Weekend Two update. After [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches, the benefit will be fully realized as we move into our regular seasonal update cadence, and players only need to compile shaders once.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Infinity Ward and Beenox have collaborated to bring Shader Preloading to [i]Call of Duty[/i]. Bringing the feature to the Beta allows us to see it working across the enormous variety of PC hardware and configurations in the community, giving the teams an opportunity to refine the experience where needed ahead of launch. We know you want to get into game as quickly as possible, and we will keep looking for ways to improve your experience for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The goal? Less time waiting. More time playing.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Update Requires Restart… Requires an Update[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL: [/b][i]For Modern Warfare 4, we’re reducing the number of situations where an update requires a restart. The experience varies by platform during the Beta, with further improvements planned for launch.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31d4c909b735825e18512bf902df61646a990f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you’ve played [i]Call of Duty[/i], you’ll definitely be familiar with “Update Requires Restart”: You launch the game, an update is applied, and you’re prompted to restart the game before continuing.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Many updates can already be applied without requiring that extra restart, including Playlist Updates, Store Updates, and other smaller updates that happen behind the scenes. With [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], we’re expanding this capability to include data patches — updates that make changes to the game without requiring a full Title Update — reducing the number of times you’ll need to restart… and see that infamous screen.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]There are still some exceptions. If you’re already playing [i]Call of Duty[/i] at the same time a new data patch goes live, you will still need to restart for the update to take effect. There are also some platform-specific differences during the Beta. Here’s what to expect:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]PC (Steam):[/b] Data patches will not require a restart in most situations. You may still need to restart if a data patch is released while the game is running.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]While “Update Requires Restart” isn’t disappearing completely, the goal is simple: fewer required restarts and fewer interruptions between you and your next match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Patch Notes Access[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL: [/b][i]Stay up to date throughout the Modern Warfare 4 Beta with the latest Patch Notes from the Infinity Ward Comms team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a12cecbeaf7e5f24eae4dc483841106cdedd00e3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect updates throughout the Beta covering everything from bug fixes and gameplay adjustments to new maps and modes. Visit the [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes"]Modern Warfare 4 Patch Notes[/url][/u] for the latest intel.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]MW4: Changes to the Install and Launch Experience for Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]For Modern Warfare 4, we’re changing how you install and launch the Beta. The Beta is a separate install from the main Call of Duty experience, allowing you to download and launch it directly from your platform.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This year, for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], we’re delivering the Beta outside of the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] install.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]With this change, players can now access and launch the MW4 Beta directly without needing to cross-launch through the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Since the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta is a separate install, it won’t download automatically as part of a regular [i]Call of Duty[/i]update. You’ll need to find the Beta on your platform and initiate the download separately.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Preloading the game begins August 20, so be sure to download ahead of time and be ready when the Beta opens. Exact times are listed later in this blog.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Launcher: What Happens at the Modern Warfare 4 Launch?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]When [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches later this year, the full game will remain part of the connected [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience, alongside [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™.[/i] Keeping the latest premium title and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] connected allows the games to share content where possible, helping reduce overall file sizes. It also means that when [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i]is updated with Season 1, you can easily switch between titles in the same session.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’re continuing to look for ways to make the overall [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience simpler and easier to navigate. Before Campaign Early Access begins, we’ll introduce an updated UI and UX for the [i]Call of Duty[/i] install, including the work-in-progress look shown below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16b937ed7567662181467dce3ee154b26c3e3bc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This continues our focus on giving each [i]Call of Duty[/i] game its own distinct identity. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches with an entirely redesigned UI, and you’ll get your first look at part of that new experience during the Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Download and Launch the Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Whether you're joining your first [i]Call of Duty[/i] Beta or returning for another deployment, getting started is straightforward, no matter your platform of choice.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]What do I need to do first?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Before downloading the Beta, make sure you're ready to play.[/p][list][*][p]Sign in with your Activision Account[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Signing in with your Activision Account allows you to:[/p][list][*][p]Carry progression across supported platforms, letting you continue with the same profile if you play on more than one platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep eligible Beta rewards tied to your Activision ID.[/p][/*][*][p]Access earned Beta rewards when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches.[/p][/*][*][p]Continue your progression if you switch between supported platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Don't have an Activision Account?[/b] Create one here before launching the Beta to ensure your progression and eligible rewards are saved.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]When is the Modern Warfare 4 Beta Available to Play?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is available during two scheduled Beta weekends.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Early Access (Weekend One)[/i][/p][p align="start"]Early Access begins at 11:00AM PT, Friday August 21 for players who have pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] on Steam. The Early Access Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00AM PT on Tuesday, August 25.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s how to participate in the Early Access Beta:[/p][list][*][p]Pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] or[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Redeem a Beta Code[/p][p align="start"][b]TIP: [/b]If you can't find the Beta, confirm it's currently live for your platform, region, and Beta access window. Also, make sure that you’re eligible to play during Early Access via pre-order / pre-purchase or redeeming a Beta Code, or you may not be able to see the Beta on your platform of choice.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]How do I redeem a Beta Code?[/i][/p][p align="start"]For further information about redeeming a [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta Code, [u][url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-4/articles/modern-warfare-4-beta-code-support"]read our support article here[/url][/u]. Beta Codes are only useful for the Early Access Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Open Beta (Weekend Two)[/i][/p][p align="start"]The Open Beta begins at 10:00AM PT, Friday August 28 for players on Steam. The Open Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00AM PT on Tuesday, September 1.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s how to participate in the Open Beta:[/p][list][*][p]The Beta is available to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Download the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta on your platform of choice.[/p][/*][*][p]No pre-order or Beta Codes are needed.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I Download and Launch the Beta?[/h3][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is downloaded separately through your platform's digital storefront. You can preload early before a Beta Weekend begins, or at any time during either Beta Weekend. Here’s how to accomplish this:[/p][list][*][p]Download and install the Beta, then launch the game once the Beta is live.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Can I preload the Modern Warfare 4 Early Access or Open Beta?[/h3][p align="start"]Providing you meet the participation criteria for the Early Access Beta (see above), you can pre-load the Early Access Beta starting at [b]9:00AM on Thursday, August 20[/b].[/p][list][*][p]All players can preload the Open Beta starting at 9:00AM on Thursday, August 26, on all platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are participating in both Beta Weekends, you only need to download the game once, as content and progression carries over from Weekend One to Two.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I download the Modern Warfare 4 Beta on Steam (PC)?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Download the Beta:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Launch Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Search for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store page.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam automatically adds the Beta to your Library and begins downloading.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Launch the Beta:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Open your Steam Library.[/p][/*][*][p]Select [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Click Play (once the Beta is live).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Frequently Asked Questions about the Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bcdd7095d005255520db2d20406b6fdd33084bc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]How can I find the Modern Warfare 4 Beta? I can't find it.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Confirm the Beta is currently live.[/p][/*][*][p]Verify your platform has access during the current Beta window.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your platform's storefront.[/p][/*][*][p]Search again for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]If the Beta is in Early Access, ensure that you’re eligible to play via pre-order / pre-purchase or a Beta Code redemption[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]The Modern Warfare 4 Beta won’t launch. How can I fix this?[/i][/p][list][*][p]Check for available updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Confirm the Beta live window has begun.[/p][/*][*][p]Relaunch the application.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Will my Modern Warfare 4 Beta rewards be available in the full game?[/i][/p][p align="start"]Yes. Eligible Beta rewards (detailed below):[/p][list][*][p]Remain tied to your Activision Account.[/p][/*][*][p]Will be available when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches on October 23.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The following Beta progress does not continue after the Beta concludes:[/p][list][*][p]Player level (Rank).[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon unlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Other in-Beta progression.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Rewards[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Progress through the Beta, level up, and unlock new cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][list][*][p]During Weekend One, the first five of the Rewards, up to “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin for Reece, can be unlocked, as the maximum Player Level you can progress to is Level 20.[/p][/*][*][p]During Weekend Two, all eight of the Rewards, up to and including the “Beta Forged” Weapon Blueprint for the ISO Nightshade SMG, can be unlocked. The maximum Player Level you can progress to is increased to Level 30.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]These rewards will not be available to earn after the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta concludes. All Beta Rewards that you unlock will be available in the full game when it releases on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p]Beta Rewards[/p][list][*][p][b]Level 4:[/b] “Through the Paces” Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 8:[/b] “First Served” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 12:[/b] “Meonjeo” Legendary Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 16:[/b] “Last Charge” Legendary Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 20:[/b] “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin – Reece[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 23:[/b] “Field Tested” Epic Spray[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 26:[/b] “Beta Rights” Epic Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 30:[/b] “Beta Forged” ISO Nightshade Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Additional Rewards[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. Keep an eye out for additional cosmetic rewards earned through a variety of activities, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Default Items (immediately available):[/b] 3 Emblems, 3 Calling Cards, 1 Spray, and 3 Loading Screens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED] Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Record Rewards:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED] Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, and Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Call of Duty: NEXT and Modern Warfare 4 Beta Twitch Drops[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Tune in and earn rewards! Link your Activision account to your Twitch® account, then watch [b]Call of Duty: NEXT[/b][i] [/i]and participating [i]Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/i] streams to earn [b]cosmetic content awarded in-game at the launch of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i][/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6332e482645e9e7f177ea9ec2e38ea553f7abdb2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty: NEXT Twitch Drops[/h3][list][*][p][b]“Gas Ready” Emblem [/b](for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Rapple Repel” Calling Card [/b](for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Ghost Helmet” Charm [/b](for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Modern Warfare 4: Beta Twitch Drops (not shown)[/h3][list][*][p][b]“Get Tactical” Emblem [/b](for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Clearing House” Calling Card [/b](for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Action Ready” Charm [/b](for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/managing-your-activision-profile"]For further details on linking your Twitch account, click here[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Development Credits[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5® and PC via Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url] [i]for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]©/TM/® 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]For more information, please visit [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][i] and [/i][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][i], and follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url][/u] and [/i][u][url="https://x.com/InfinityWard"]@InfinityWard[/url][/u][i] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. newsitems.title: The International Main Event
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International: Streams, Secret Shop, and More
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]English: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Russian: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Spanish: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url]; Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Dota 2 Heroes Around Shanghai[/h3][p]From August 13 to August 18, multiple Dota heroes will descend upon iconic landmarks across Shanghai, with a giant Aegis of Champions making its grand debut. Meanwhile, several commercial districts have set up check-in spots for fans to visit and collect souvenirs.[/p][p]Check out the landmark details below or visit [url="https://act.dota2.com.cn/2026/shanghaitour"]Perfect World's Shanghai Dota Tour site[/url] for a handy map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dota Hero Landmark Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Wujiaochang Commercial District[/p][/*][*][p]Wujiaochang Guangchang: Aegis of Champions[/p][/*][*][p]Bailian ZX Fun Mall: Queen of Pain, Axe, and Pudge[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza: Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Lujiazui Super Brand Mall (Aug 12-18): Windranger[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai EXPO Culture Park (Aug 13-18): Mars and Shadow Fiend[/p][/*][*][p]Taikoo Li Qiantan (Aug 18–24): Aegis of Champions, Drow Ranger, Crystal Maiden, and Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Check-in Spots: Lujiazui 96 Plaza, New bund 31, Shanghai No. 1 Shopping Center, Expo Place[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Secret Shops[/h3][p]If you're looking to scope out this year's merchandise offerings, our partner stores are already online for both Chinese and international customers.[/p][list][*][p]For China domestic fans: [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For fans everywhere else: [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Secret Shop will also operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last match series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from onsite cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Streams[/h3][p]The strength of Dota has always been its vibrant and passionate community. The International is an expression of that, both the in-person event and the many millions who participate online, those watching and those streaming.[/p][p]Speaking of which: As always, we welcome community streams of the event. There's more detail in [url="https://www.dota2.com/dotatv"]the community stream FAQ[/url], but to summarize: You have a lot of freedom in how to stream your TI commentary the way you and your viewers want as long as your stream is based on DotaTV and your own content, not on someone else's stream (including ours).[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrapping Up[/h3][p]There's obviously a lot going on already, but there's even more info about The International to come. We'll be back soon to provide more details about on-site events, badges, Crimson Witness drops and more as we move closer to the show. Until then, make sure to get those predictions in. We'll see you when groups start.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5c825b3d35627bfc4276c013745aa6fd4de935ea.png[/img]

Nearly a year has passed since Team Falcons hoisted the Aegis of Champions as the final team standing in Hamburg. But that was last year's story, and the time has come to turn our thoughts to Shanghai and the crop of competitors who vie to write the tale of [i]this[/i] year. All of their battles have brought them to the precipice. The International is just two weeks away.

After a decisive month of intense qualifiers, dominant performances from prior champions, and upset victories from up-and-comers, all sixteen teams have earned their invitations to this year's International.

Now it's time for us to extend an invitation to you.

We've just released an update featuring this year's TI-themed activities and item bundles. Not sure what that means? Keep reading for a handy guide to all the different ways to participate so you can find the content that's most interesting to you.

[list][*][b]I want to directly support my favorite teams and personalities.[/b][/list]
With supporter bundles for all sixteen teams and more than a hundred participating event talent, there's never been a better time to support your favorites. In addition to the four primary event languages, this year we're also offering community bundles for WXC Co. (Filipino), NS_ART (Brazilian Portuguese), and Maincast (Ukrainian). 50% of sales from supporter bundles (teams, talent, and community broadcasts) goes directly to the team or talent and 30% goes to the tournament prize pool.

[list][*][b]I want to show off that I supported my favorite team.[/b][/list]
Purchasing team supporter bundles of various levels will grant all kinds of things: custom sprays, a special badge for your health bar, custom team emoticons, custom chat wheel lines, and — new this year as a part of the Gold tier — a global effigy. This new building will replace your regular effigy through the end of September, allowing you to show your team support right in your base. Not supportive enough? You can purchase additional supporter levels that will upgrade the appearance of your effigy, including custom effects.

[list][*][b]I'm right about everything. Help me prove it.[/b][/list]
Predictions are back: How will the Swiss matches shake out? What about the bracket? Fun fact: Exactly zero have ever gotten the full Swiss stage results correct. Will you be the first this year? Not if you don't get your guesses in before the first match starts (10am CST, Thursday 8/13).

[list][*][b]I'm a huge fan of my favorite team but also I dislike all of their choices and wish I was in charge.[/b][/list]
We've got a new take on fantasy this year. We've introduced a new customization point: You. You're the coach, and can now assign custom modifiers to yourself that influence your whole team. We've also updated prefixes, suffixes, and the player drafting rules. You'll draft your perfect team in (mostly) pairs: both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner. 

[list][*][b]I am a Dota player and I'm already assuming I'll be the best at everything. What do I win?[/b][/list]
Like last year, awards will be granted to participating players based on their performance relative to everyone else. The Tyrian Regalia treasure is making a royal return with five refashioned Immortal items, exclusively available to the top performing players. New this year is the Terrain Token, which will allow winners to choose one of six returning custom terrains, including Reef's Edge and Immortal Gardens. Look for more information, including reward tiers and lots of details, in the Rewards section of the main Dota 2 menu.

[list][*][b]All of this is great but I did my predictions and my fantasy and supported the teams and talent already. What do I do [i]now[/i]?[/b][/list]
Good news for you: We also just shipped a new gameplay patch along with a ton of content fixes. Check out the [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]Summer Scrub 2026[/url] page for more details.

Today we're shipping the Ranked Series of Cologne 2026 Major stickers--new stickers that indicate a team's final standing in the design. As with all items in the Cologne 2026 Shop, 50% of the royalties support the teams, players and tournament organizer.

The original dynamic pricing system determined the relative interest in players and teams, but it didn't produce reasonable prices. So the Ranked stickers have a lower price, but with the same relationship between players and teams as the Event Series stickers (as of today's update).

Check out the new stickers and support your favorite players and teams! The Cologne 2026 Shop will be available until September 29th.

newsitems.title: Discussion time: Have you ever said goodbye to an MMO you've played for 1,000s of hours?

newsitems.title: Warframe creative director says Destiny 2's end is tragic, because even with hard work 'the business side of this industry always gets the last remark'

newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 isn't going anywhere, but it also isn't… well, going anywhere. The game's servers will still be running for the foreseeable future, but Bungie has since ceased updates to its flagship shooter to move onto other projects, tragically laying off much of its staff in the aftermath of that decision... newsitems.title: Destiny 2 players get a final farewell gift from Bungie

newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 is done: The final patch is out, Bungie is decimated, and the game will remain playable but the story of one of the biggest, best and most influential online shooters ever is over.
